title: presidio-hardened-vol-assign
description: Reproducible multi-objective post-disaster assignment tool combining fuzzy inference systems with the NSGA-II, NRGA, and NSGA-III evolutionary algorithms. Two domains: humanitarian people-to-relief-centre allocation (four-objective, mapped to the Bruneau et al. 4R resilience framework, plus a baseline three-objective model) and emergency-department volunteer staffing (Rabiei et al., ESWA 2023). Includes bit-for-bit reproducibility, sensitivity/ablation tooling, and the experiment drivers behind the Applied Sciences (MDPI) paper.
